article.title: Service tax levied by Union and collected and appropriated by the Union and the States
article.content: Omitted by the Constitution (One Hundred and First Amendment) Act, 2016, s. 7 (w.e.f. 16-9-2016).
article.html:
268AService tax levied by Union and collected and appropriated by the Union and the States

Article 268A · Part XII · Distribution of Revenues between the Union and the States

Omitted by the Constitution (One Hundred and First Amendment) Act, 2016, s. 7 (w.e.f. 16-9-2016).

1 Ins. by the Constitution (Eighty-eighth Amendment) Act, 2003, s. 2 (date not notifed).
